description: Everything the whiteboard window needs. The daemon is reached through this crate's own commands, so no HTTP-scope permission is required. `opener` needs both halves: allow-open-url grants the command, allow-default-urls grants the http/https scope it checks the URL against — with only the first, every open_url is refused at runtime and a footnote's Google search silently falls back to an in-app window. Child-webview control moved to `desktop-webview.json`, which is platform-scoped; `allow-webview-eval-json` stays here because the command itself answers Android with a sentence rather than a permission error — and on Android it now answers with the page, through the `livewebview` plugin. `allow-live-webview` is that plugin's bridge and stays here for the same reason: it is inert off Android rather than dangerous there.
